findings.highlight: stand the silver-haired girl and Emiya Shirou, hand in hand
findings.evidenceJa: 手を繋いで立ち尽くす
findings.governingReading: Shirou and Illya stand holding hands, frozen in place.
findings.explanation: The English preserves their stance and joined hands but omits that they are standing transfixed.

findings.evidenceJa: 恥知らずにも際限なく膨れ上がり
findings.governingReading: The shadow swells without limit with a personified shamelessness.
findings.explanation: The English deletes the evaluative personification and the renewed lack of limit.

findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎を避けて通った
findings.governingReading: The spreading shadow travels around Shirou because he lies in the depression.
findings.explanation: “Passes over” reverses the spatial protection and suggests the shadow crosses him.

findings.highlight: to follow the situation without ever leaving the house
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮邸からでも様子が判るように
findings.governingReading: Sakura shares Rider’s sight so she can know what is happening even from the Emiya residence.
findings.explanation: The English adds the absolute idea that she never leaves the house.

findings.highlight: covering her mouth with her hands
findings.governingReading: She covers her mouth with one hand while running.
findings.explanation: The English makes the hand plural.

findings.highlight: as soon as she gets to the sink
findings.evidenceJa: 呼吸をせずに洗面台にすがりついて
findings.governingReading: She reaches the washbasin without breathing and clings to it.
findings.explanation: The English deletes both breath-holding and her desperate grip on the sink.

findings.governingReading: Sakura turns the thought against herself in bitter self-reproach.
findings.explanation: The English invents audible yelling and recasts self-denigration as masochism.

findings.highlight: Was it simply carelessness that made her wish
findings.evidenceJa: どれほど軽率な願いだったのか
findings.governingReading: She recognizes how terribly reckless the wish itself was.
findings.explanation: The English asks whether mere carelessness caused the wish, changing both syntax and moral emphasis.

findings.highlight: the sharp pain in her stomach
findings.evidenceJa: 切り刻まれるような腹部の痛み
findings.governingReading: Her abdomen hurts as though it is being cut to pieces.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the violent simile to ordinary sharp pain and changes abdomen to stomach.
The English minimizes the injury to an external-sounding scratch.

findings.governingReading: Several tens of minutes pass before the vomiting subsides.
findings.explanation: The English removes the substantial duration.

findings.highlight: a face with a crooked smile
findings.evidenceJa: 口元を歪めて笑う横顔
findings.governingReading: The mirror shows her profile, mouth distorted into a smile.
findings.explanation: The English loses the profile composition and reduces an actively distorted mouth to a static “crooked smile.”
